rounds: Pop stars and actors should stick to what they are famous for.
Celebrity brands are mostly a way for famous people to get even richer.
Influencers sell products better than film stars or pop stars do.
I would rather buy from a small, unknown brand than from a famous one.
Celebrity beauty brands push young people towards unrealistic beauty standards.
Adverts for make-up should show ordinary people, not famous faces.
In ten years, men will buy as much make-up as women.
Fans who queue for hours for a new product are being taken advantage of.
